meta.title: Scorched Earth
meta.description: Our deepest attachments are to that planet.

units.rawText: Titan Base
units.displayText: Titan Base

spans.text: Titan Base

units.rawText: Yuwang, where's the Millennium Pegasus?
units.displayText: Yuwang, where's the Millennium Pegasus?

spans.text: Yuwang, where's the Millennium Pegasus?

units.rawText: Xinghuan delivers the terminal she brought back to Yuwang's hands while pulling the trigger of her weapon, sweeping the nearby entropics with bullets.
units.displayText: Xinghuan delivers the terminal she brought back to Yuwang's hands while pulling the trigger of her weapon, sweeping the nearby entropics with bullets.

spans.text: Xinghuan delivers the terminal she brought back to Yuwang's hands while pulling the trigger of her weapon, sweeping the nearby entropics with bullets.

units.rawText: It's on the landing pad. What took you so long?
units.displayText: It's on the landing pad. What took you so long?

spans.text: It's on the landing pad. What took you so long?

units.rawText: Who would have thought the download progress bar would be stuck at 97% for so long! The entropics nearly broke through the Data Center's main door!
units.displayText: Who would have thought the download progress bar would be stuck at 97% for so long! The entropics nearly broke through the Data Center's main door!

spans.text: Who would have thought the download progress bar would be stuck at 97% for so long! The entropics nearly broke through the Data Center's main door!

units.rawText: Anyway, we can save the chit-chat for later. You lead the way. I'll cover you.
units.displayText: Anyway, we can save the chit-chat for later. You lead the way. I'll cover you.

spans.text: Anyway, we can save the chit-chat for later. You lead the way. I'll cover you.

units.rawText: Yuwang was aware that his movement speed is nowhere near enough to keep up with Xinghuan. He heads toward the hangar elevator as quickly as he can so as not to slow her down.
units.displayText: Yuwang was aware that his movement speed is nowhere near enough to keep up with Xinghuan. He heads toward the hangar elevator as quickly as he can so as not to slow her down.

spans.text: Yuwang was aware that his movement speed is nowhere near enough to keep up with Xinghuan. He heads toward the hangar elevator as quickly as he can so as not to slow her down.

units.rawText: The entropics nearby sense Yuwang's comparative lack of mobility and attempt to jump down from above to waylay him.
units.displayText: The entropics nearby sense Yuwang's comparative lack of mobility and attempt to jump down from above to waylay him.

spans.text: The entropics nearby sense Yuwang's comparative lack of mobility and attempt to jump down from above to waylay him.

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: However, Yuwang does not slow down in the least. Just as an entropic tentacle is about to touch his wheelchair, a spray of gunfire cuts it off.
units.displayText: However, Yuwang does not slow down in the least. Just as an entropic tentacle is about to touch his wheelchair, a spray of gunfire cuts it off.

spans.text: However, Yuwang does not slow down in the least. Just as an entropic tentacle is about to touch his wheelchair, a spray of gunfire cuts it off.

units.rawText: Bangbangbang!
units.displayText: Bangbangbang!

spans.text: Bangbangbang!

units.rawText: Who said you could go after my partner? I'm your opponent, in case you forgot.
units.displayText: Who said you could go after my partner? I'm your opponent, in case you forgot.

spans.text: Who said you could go after my partner? I'm your opponent, in case you forgot.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, the blast door will take 30 seconds to lower.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, the blast door will take 30 seconds to lower.

spans.text: Xinghuan, the blast door will take 30 seconds to lower.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: Xinghuan shoots back with her hand-held gun and covers Yuwang as he goes through the door. An electrical motor whirs loudly as the blast door fully shuts.
units.displayText: Xinghuan shoots back with her hand-held gun and covers Yuwang as he goes through the door. An electrical motor whirs loudly as the blast door fully shuts.

spans.text: Xinghuan shoots back with her hand-held gun and covers Yuwang as he goes through the door. An electrical motor whirs loudly as the blast door fully shuts.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, hurry!
units.displayText: Xinghuan, hurry!

spans.text: Xinghuan, hurry!

units.rawText: Got it... here's one last big one for you before I go!
units.displayText: Got it... here's one last big one for you before I go!

spans.text: Got it... here's one last big one for you before I go!

units.rawText: <size=40>MIRV Missile! FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: MIRV Missile! FIRE!

spans.text: MIRV Missile! FIRE!

units.rawText: Xinghuan pulls her trigger and a missile streaks toward the entropic horde before splitting into multiple smaller submunitions, consuming the nearest entropics in fire and steel.
units.displayText: Xinghuan pulls her trigger and a missile streaks toward the entropic horde before splitting into multiple smaller submunitions, consuming the nearest entropics in fire and steel.

spans.text: Xinghuan pulls her trigger and a missile streaks toward the entropic horde before splitting into multiple smaller submunitions, consuming the nearest entropics in fire and steel.

units.rawText: Then, in a series of fluid movements, Xinghuan maxes out the throttle, adjusts the facing of her exo, and uses her momentum to execute a sliding dash. Her leg armor throws up a shower of sparks where it's in contact with the ground.
units.displayText: Then, in a series of fluid movements, Xinghuan maxes out the throttle, adjusts the facing of her exo, and uses her momentum to execute a sliding dash. Her leg armor throws up a shower of sparks where it's in contact with the ground.

spans.text: Then, in a series of fluid movements, Xinghuan maxes out the throttle, adjusts the facing of her exo, and uses her momentum to execute a sliding dash. Her leg armor throws up a shower of sparks where it's in contact with the ground.

units.rawText: Yeeart!!!
units.displayText: Yeeart!!!

spans.text: Yeeart!!!

units.rawText:
"Thunk."
The blast door shuts completely. Xinghuan, who made it into the hangar elevator area, leans tiredly against the doorway. She can still hear the desperate howling of the entropics through the thick metal.
units.displayText:
"Thunk."

units.rawText: Whew... at least we finally got rid of those monsters. Oh yeah, where are those little guys who were supposed to be with you?
units.displayText: Whew... at least we finally got rid of those monsters. Oh yeah, where are those little guys who were supposed to be with you?

spans.text: Whew... at least we finally got rid of those monsters. Oh yeah, where are those little guys who were supposed to be with you?

units.rawText: ...Let's go. We'll be leaving right away.
units.displayText: ...Let's go. We'll be leaving right away.

spans.text: ...Let's go. We'll be leaving right away.

units.rawText: As Yuwang steers his wheelchair into the cockpit, uneasiness begins welling up inside Xinghuan's heart.
units.displayText: As Yuwang steers his wheelchair into the cockpit, uneasiness begins welling up inside Xinghuan's heart.

spans.text: As Yuwang steers his wheelchair into the cockpit, uneasiness begins welling up inside Xinghuan's heart.

units.rawText: Yuwang? Where are they?!
units.displayText: Yuwang? Where are they?!

spans.text: Yuwang? Where are they?!

units.rawText: They... aren't here anymore.
units.displayText: They... aren't here anymore.

spans.text: They... aren't here anymore.

units.rawText: What... What did you say?!
units.displayText: What... What did you say?!

spans.text: What... What did you say?!

units.rawText: The generator complex was being entropized. The research agents went in to clear out the nearby entropics to save Generator No. 6.
units.displayText: The generator complex was being entropized. The research agents went in to clear out the nearby entropics to save Generator No. 6.

spans.text: The generator complex was being entropized. The research agents went in to clear out the nearby entropics to save Generator No. 6.

units.rawText: I tried hailing them many times after that, but I didn't get a response...
units.displayText: I tried hailing them many times after that, but I didn't get a response...

spans.text: I tried hailing them many times after that, but I didn't get a response...

units.rawText: Xinghuan's body starts trembling uncontrollably and her voice grows hoarse.
units.displayText: Xinghuan's body starts trembling uncontrollably and her voice grows hoarse.

spans.text: Xinghuan's body starts trembling uncontrollably and her voice grows hoarse.

units.rawText: They...
units.displayText: They...

spans.text: They...

units.rawText: Love science, protect data!
units.displayText: Love science, protect data!

spans.text: Love science, protect data!

units.rawText: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.
units.displayText: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

spans.text: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

units.rawText: After the first mini-robot speaks, all the mini-robots turn to Xinghuan and begin chanting the slogan.
units.displayText: After the first mini-robot speaks, all the mini-robots turn to Xinghuan and begin chanting the slogan.

spans.text: After the first mini-robot speaks, all the mini-robots turn to Xinghuan and begin chanting the slogan.

units.rawText: ...Yeah, we'll return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.
units.displayText: ...Yeah, we'll return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

spans.text: ...Yeah, we'll return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry... I'll make sure I reset you.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry... I'll make sure I reset you.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry... I'll make sure I reset you.

units.rawText: They died to protect the data. If we can send Huygens II and its data safely back to Jupiter, it'll have been worth it.
units.displayText: They died to protect the data. If we can send Huygens II and its data safely back to Jupiter, it'll have been worth it.

spans.text: They died to protect the data. If we can send Huygens II and its data safely back to Jupiter, it'll have been worth it.

units.rawText: That's right... And we have to wipe out all those entropics, too!
units.displayText: That's right... And we have to wipe out all those entropics, too!

spans.text: That's right... And we have to wipe out all those entropics, too!

units.rawText: What's our next move? Bring Pan over and crash it into Titan?
units.displayText: What's our next move? Bring Pan over and crash it into Titan?

spans.text: What's our next move? Bring Pan over and crash it into Titan?

units.rawText: ...That's not possible....
units.displayText: ...That's not possible....

spans.text: ...That's not possible....

units.rawText: Yuwang sighs, and the air grows heavy.
units.displayText: Yuwang sighs, and the air grows heavy.

spans.text: Yuwang sighs, and the air grows heavy.

units.rawText: The comet's course has deviated so far from projections that we can't compensate for it just by changing Pan's vector.
units.displayText: The comet's course has deviated so far from projections that we can't compensate for it just by changing Pan's vector.

spans.text: The comet's course has deviated so far from projections that we can't compensate for it just by changing Pan's vector.

units.rawText: Even if we tried to turn Pan around to hit the comet, it would take long enough that the entropics would be able to finish devastating Titan and then set their sights on the Jovian Ringworld.
units.displayText: Even if we tried to turn Pan around to hit the comet, it would take long enough that the entropics would be able to finish devastating Titan and then set their sights on the Jovian Ringworld.

spans.text: Even if we tried to turn Pan around to hit the comet, it would take long enough that the entropics would be able to finish devastating Titan and then set their sights on the Jovian Ringworld.

units.rawText: So you're saying... We're going to abandon the Saturnian system.
units.displayText: So you're saying... We're going to abandon the Saturnian system.

spans.text: So you're saying... We're going to abandon the Saturnian system.

units.rawText: Yes... We'll be abandoning Saturn and retreating to the Jovian Ringworld. Xuannu has begun gathering our forces there.
units.displayText: Yes... We'll be abandoning Saturn and retreating to the Jovian Ringworld. Xuannu has begun gathering our forces there.

spans.text: Yes... We'll be abandoning Saturn and retreating to the Jovian Ringworld. Xuannu has begun gathering our forces there.

units.rawText: Get your exo strapped in, we'll be taking off soon.
units.displayText: Get your exo strapped in, we'll be taking off soon.

spans.text: Get your exo strapped in, we'll be taking off soon.

units.rawText: Countdown to launch starting in...
units.displayText: Countdown to launch starting in...

spans.text: Countdown to launch starting in...

units.rawText: Alert, cabin pressure air anomaly.
units.displayText: Alert, cabin pressure air anomaly.

spans.text: Alert, cabin pressure air anomaly.

units.rawText: What?! Xinghuan?!
units.displayText: What?! Xinghuan?!

spans.text: What?! Xinghuan?!

units.rawText: Through the cameras, Yuwang sees that Xinghuan has already gotten back in her exo and leaped off the Millennium Pegasus.
units.displayText: Through the cameras, Yuwang sees that Xinghuan has already gotten back in her exo and leaped off the Millennium Pegasus.

spans.text: Through the cameras, Yuwang sees that Xinghuan has already gotten back in her exo and leaped off the Millennium Pegasus.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, what are you doing?!
units.displayText: Xinghuan, what are you doing?!

spans.text: Xinghuan, what are you doing?!

units.rawText: Sorry, Yuwang. Go on without me.
units.displayText: Sorry, Yuwang. Go on without me.

spans.text: Sorry, Yuwang. Go on without me.

units.rawText: What is it this time?! We've recovered all the data, and there's nothing valuable left on Titan!
units.displayText: What is it this time?! We've recovered all the data, and there's nothing valuable left on Titan!

spans.text: What is it this time?! We've recovered all the data, and there's nothing valuable left on Titan!

units.rawText: ...No, there is.
units.displayText: ...No, there is.

spans.text: ...No, there is.

units.rawText: I'll think of a way to buy the Ringworld time.
units.displayText: I'll think of a way to buy the Ringworld time.

spans.text: I'll think of a way to buy the Ringworld time.

units.rawText: If this is meant to be a joke, I'm not laughing. Come back, if we can enlist the Ringworld's forces and the defensive emplacements there, we might have a chance of taking the entropics out in a showdown...
units.displayText: If this is meant to be a joke, I'm not laughing. Come back, if we can enlist the Ringworld's forces and the defensive emplacements there, we might have a chance of taking the entropics out in a showdown...

spans.text: If this is meant to be a joke, I'm not laughing. Come back, if we can enlist the Ringworld's forces and the defensive emplacements there, we might have a chance of taking the entropics out in a showdown...

units.rawText: Do you think I don't know what kind of state the Ringworld is in?
units.displayText: Do you think I don't know what kind of state the Ringworld is in?

spans.text: Do you think I don't know what kind of state the Ringworld is in?

units.rawText: Even if we do destroy the entropics at the Ringworld... It's still our home. Many of us will die, and we'll lose what we ought to have protected...
units.displayText: Even if we do destroy the entropics at the Ringworld... It's still our home. Many of us will die, and we'll lose what we ought to have protected...

spans.text: Even if we do destroy the entropics at the Ringworld... It's still our home. Many of us will die, and we'll lose what we ought to have protected...

units.rawText: But right now, we have a chance to save the situation. At the very least, I'm going to fight to the end for what I want to defend, like those mini-robots.
units.displayText: But right now, we have a chance to save the situation. At the very least, I'm going to fight to the end for what I want to defend, like those mini-robots.

spans.text: But right now, we have a chance to save the situation. At the very least, I'm going to fight to the end for what I want to defend, like those mini-robots.

units.rawText: If you charge in there without a plan, it's no different from committing suicide!
units.displayText: If you charge in there without a plan, it's no different from committing suicide!

spans.text: If you charge in there without a plan, it's no different from committing suicide!

units.rawText: The effects of ambient entropization make the signal choppy. Xinghuan's image grows blurry in the transmission window, but a faint hint of mirth still makes it through the voice channel.
units.displayText: The effects of ambient entropization make the signal choppy. Xinghuan's image grows blurry in the transmission window, but a faint hint of mirth still makes it through the voice channel.

spans.text: The effects of ambient entropization make the signal choppy. Xinghuan's image grows blurry in the transmission window, but a faint hint of mirth still makes it through the voice channel.

units.rawText: Relax, I've thought of a way... We might be able to restart the plan after all...
units.displayText: Relax, I've thought of a way... We might be able to restart the plan after all...

spans.text: Relax, I've thought of a way... We might be able to restart the plan after all...

units.rawText: Restart the... Wait! Xinghuan, are you going to—
units.displayText: Restart the... Wait! Xinghuan, are you going to—

spans.text: Restart the... Wait! Xinghuan, are you going to—

units.rawText: The base is too heavily entropized! There's no guarantee that it'll even work!
units.displayText: The base is too heavily entropized! There's no guarantee that it'll even work!

spans.text: The base is too heavily entropized! There's no guarantee that it'll even work!

units.rawText: Sorry, partner... I'll be bothering you again for this...
units.displayText: Sorry, partner... I'll be bothering you again for this...

spans.text: Sorry, partner... I'll be bothering you again for this...

units.rawText: Her voice grows more and more distant until the transmission cuts off due to poor signal conditions.
units.displayText: Her voice grows more and more distant until the transmission cuts off due to poor signal conditions.

spans.text: Her voice grows more and more distant until the transmission cuts off due to poor signal conditions.

units.rawText: No, no, no... The Millennium Pegasus can return on autopilot; I need to find Xinghuan!
units.displayText: No, no, no... The Millennium Pegasus can return on autopilot; I need to find Xinghuan!

spans.text: No, no, no... The Millennium Pegasus can return on autopilot; I need to find Xinghuan!

units.rawText: Xinghuan is about to head for the door when an unexpected guest suddenly blocks his path.
units.displayText: Xinghuan is about to head for the door when an unexpected guest suddenly blocks his path.

spans.text: Xinghuan is about to head for the door when an unexpected guest suddenly blocks his path.

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Liuxing?! What are you doing! Let me go!
units.displayText: Liuxing?! What are you doing! Let me go!

spans.text: Liuxing?! What are you doing! Let me go!

units.rawText: Xinghuan's chances by herself are too low, I need to help her!
units.displayText: Xinghuan's chances by herself are too low, I need to help her!

spans.text: Xinghuan's chances by herself are too low, I need to help her!

units.rawText: Beepbeep...
units.displayText: Beepbeep...

spans.text: Beepbeep...

units.rawText: Launch command? Wait... no...
units.displayText: Launch command? Wait... no...

spans.text: Launch command? Wait... no...

units.rawText: 3... 2... 1... Millennium Pegasus, taking off!
units.displayText: 3... 2... 1... Millennium Pegasus, taking off!

spans.text: 3... 2... 1... Millennium Pegasus, taking off!

units.rawText: The spaceship's engines ignite as planned, and the vessel races across the shrouded sky.
units.displayText: The spaceship's engines ignite as planned, and the vessel races across the shrouded sky.

spans.text: The spaceship's engines ignite as planned, and the vessel races across the shrouded sky.

units.displayText: Xinghuan watches as her partner flies further and further away from her until the ship vanishes from sight.

spans.text: Xinghuan watches as her partner flies further and further away from her until the ship vanishes from sight.

units.rawText: Make sure you get back safely, partner.
units.displayText: Make sure you get back safely, partner.

spans.text: Make sure you get back safely, partner.

units.rawText: The rest is up to me.
units.displayText: The rest is up to me.

spans.text: The rest is up to me.

units.rawText: Xinghuan opens the surveillance terminal near the landing pad and watches as the dark purple entropic hordes continue spreading.
units.displayText: Xinghuan opens the surveillance terminal near the landing pad and watches as the dark purple entropic hordes continue spreading.

spans.text: Xinghuan opens the surveillance terminal near the landing pad and watches as the dark purple entropic hordes continue spreading.

units.rawText: In their midst stands their leader, radiating operand fluctuations that are so powerful that they're distorting the image—a human-shaped High Order Entropic.
units.displayText: In their midst stands their leader, radiating operand fluctuations that are so powerful that they're distorting the image—a human-shaped High Order Entropic.

spans.text: In their midst stands their leader, radiating operand fluctuations that are so powerful that they're distorting the image—a human-shaped High Order Entropic.

units.rawText: <color=purple>...Hehe...</color>
units.displayText: ...Hehe...

spans.text: ...Hehe...

units.displayText: The High Order Entropic grabs the camera and smiles evilly into the lens.

units.displayText: Crack.

units.displayText: The surveillance camera image instantly goes dark, just like the surrounding equipment.

spans.text: The surveillance camera image instantly goes dark, just like the surrounding equipment.

units.rawText: ...I need... to get it done ASAP...
units.displayText: ...I need... to get it done ASAP...

spans.text: ...I need... to get it done ASAP...

units.rawText: Before she fully entropizes the base...
units.displayText: Before she fully entropizes the base...
